title: VisionQuest benchmark result
description: One suite's run, written to reports/benchmarks/latest/<suite>.json by scripts/bench/run.mjs. Validated by scripts/bench/lib/result.mjs against a hand-rolled checker covering the subset of JSON Schema used here (type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, enum, minimum). Keep both in step.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the run start.

commit.description: Short commit SHA the run measured, or null outside a git checkout.

provider.description: AI provider the suite exercised (gemini, ollama), or null for a deterministic suite.

model.description: Exact model tag, never the provider class — the 2026-08-21 LlmCallLog lesson.

status.description: Worst metric status, or skipped/error set by the runner.

skipped.description: Why the suite did not run — present only when status is skipped.

error.description: The scorer's failure — present only when status is error.

displayUnit.description: Free-form label the config declared ("usd", "students/week"); carried through untouched for the dashboard. `unit` stays the enum every reader formats by.

reason.description: Why a gate/nightly metric carries "floor": null — the owner-documented info case.

details.description: Free-form evidence from the scorer (missed cases, offenders). Never student data.
